title: Can Attribution Graphs Predict Token Probabilities on Novel Inputs?
original_idea: On GPT-2 Small, construct a simplified attribution graph for a well-studied circuit on 50 prompts. Use the graph to predict token probability rankings on 50 novel prompts. Report prediction accuracy vs. attention-pattern baseline.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests predictive validity of attribution graphs, which is necessary for prospective safety auditing. Clear and important.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Constructing a simplified attribution graph and using it for prediction is conceptually complex for beginners. TransformerLens helps but the methodology is non-trivial.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined: 50 train, 50 test prompts, top-1/top-5 accuracy, one baseline comparison. Clear deliverable.

novelty.reasoning: No novelty assessment available; default estimated score assigned.
